video_title: Jalen Brunson Claps Back at Becky Hammon & Looks Back at the Origin of His Iconic Celebration

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson addresses criticism regarding his departure from the Dallas Mavericks
quotes.excerpt: They made decisions, and I'll leave it at that.
quotes.quote: They made decisions, and I'll leave it at that.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the impact of playing alongside Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: Being drafted with him was special because I learned a lot my rookie year by watching him.
quotes.quote: Being drafted with him was special because I learned a lot my rookie year by watching him. Even though he was a couple years younger than me, he was already great in everything he did. He never let anyone speed him up; he was a well-oiled machine already. It was something that I thought I had, but I still had a lot to learn. Being able to grow with him as friends and teammates and as players made me better.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on his mindset when joining the New York Knicks
quotes.excerpt: My mindset was to be myself and do what I can to contribute to winning.
quotes.quote: My mindset was to be myself and do what I can to contribute to winning. I never really wanted to come in and say, 'I'm going to change this, I'm going to change that.' It was just, I'm going to be myself and put us in a great position to be successful by trusting everything that I do, trusting my work and trusting my mindset.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on his interaction with Stephen A. Smith
quotes.excerpt: I always will troll him for the things that he said when I first signed in New York.
quotes.quote: I always will troll him for the things that he said when I first signed in New York. That was a cool moment for sure.
